name: testfly-mobile-inspector
description: Inspect iOS and Android screens through mobilecli: live screenshot, UI tree with @eN refs, element details and ready-to-paste TestFly @MobileFind selectors.

testflyInspector.serverUrl.description: URL of the mobilecli server (JSON-RPC at /rpc).

testflyInspector.mobilecliPath.description: mobilecli executable used to start the server when it is not running.

testflyInspector.autoStartServer.description: Run 'mobilecli server start' when a local server does not answer.

testflyInspector.autoRefreshAfterAction.description: Read the screen again after a tap, swipe, text or button action.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Inspect an iOS or Android screen through mobilecli: screenshot, UI tree with @eN refs and ready-to-paste TestFly selectors.
[$(device-mobile) Open Mobile Inspector](command:testflyInspector.open)
Needs mobilecli and a booted simulator, emulator or device. [Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22testflyInspector%22%5D)
